snippet.title: Infinity Nikki Version 2.8 Trailer | Golden Dust
snippet.description:
The age of Titans was forged in gold.
Happiness and glory lingered like the afterglow of sunset.
A thousand years of old wounds swirl within the cup.
Judgment looms on high, yet the final ruling has yet to fall.
With soul as bow and conviction as arrow, darkness shall be pierced—

Version 2.8 of Infinity Nikki "Golden Dust" officially launches on July 16 (UTC-7)!
The final chapter of Itzaland's main story, "Golden Dust," opens alongside a new region, and a dungeon. Fun event gameplay updates including [Everbloom Mystery] and [Skyline Rush] will also arrive, along with reward events. Stylists, be sure to check them out!

——
➤ Infinity Nikki Version 2.8 Golden Dust launches globally on July 16 (UTC-7)!
